findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 1, Harm 3
Raise: Functional. Case: normal use - A run waits for memory or CPU load while Forge 1.2.38 is on PATH. That release's `src/forge/machine.py:182-198,260-289,427-440` can report `place: 0` for an unadmitted run and does not provide `waiting`. This fallback therefore displays the waiting run as running and can count its place as occupied. The new test covers a waiter with `place: 1`, so this part of the previous finding remains.
findings.title: Reject incomplete lane data from an older Forge

findings.body:
Gain 2, Work 1, Harm 1
Raise: Functional. Case: normal use - A person uses the documented `forge read pane-decision` form. `src/forge/records.py:797-821` resolves it to a numbered file such as `docs/decisions/0045-pane-decision.md`, but `src/forge/machine.py:214-216` looks for `docs/decisions/pane-decision.md`. The resulting null title makes this fallback show the slug instead of the decision heading. The new test uses the numbered form, so the previous decision-title issue remains for the documented unnumbered form.
